history: Chongqing has 3,000 years of history, nicknamed 'Yu' after the old name of the Jialing River. It was named 'Chongqing' (double celebration) when it became a prefecture in the Southern Song dynasty, 800 years ago. As the wartime capital during WWII, it witnessed a nation's resistance. The Yangtze and Jialing rivers meet at Chaotianmen, and the 8D magic city — with trains passing through buildings — is an internet sensation. It is the only municipality in central-western China and the economic center of the upper Yangtze.
importance: Municipality · National central city · Mountain city on two rivers
